title: loomplane.yaml
description: What an application deploys with Loomplane, where, and what it needs. Version 1.

version.description: The manifest version. This schema is version 1.

defaults.description: Apply to every service and resource that doesn't set its own. The default region only comes with the default provider.

services.description: What the application runs, by name.

resources.description: Backing services the application needs, such as Postgres, by name. A resource can't share a service's name.

gateways.description: Public entry points that route requests to services by path, by name. Loomplane builds each one on Bastion and runs it like a service. A gateway can't share a service's or resource's name.

ignore.description: What repository analysis found that the application doesn't use.

provider.description: Where it runs, by the provider's name in Loomplane's registry, such as cloud-run, ecs-fargate, vercel or render.

region.description: The provider's region, such as us-central1 or eu-west-1.

port.description: The port the service listens on. Without it, the one its Dockerfile exposes.

public.description: Whether the service gets an address on the internet. Without it, yes for anything serving HTTP and no for a worker.

repo.description: The alias of the repository the service is in. A project with one repository can leave it out.

source.description: Where the service's code is, as repository analysis found it: a Go main package's directory, a Rust binary's source file, a Node package's, Python project's or JVM module's directory, or a Dockerfile. Prefix the ecosystem (go:, rust:, node:, python:, jvm:, container:) when two have a service at the same path.

kind.description: Corrects what analysis decided the service is.

build.description: How the service's Dockerfile is built.

context.description: The directory the build runs in, from the repository's root: . for the root itself. Empty uses what analysis found, which is the Dockerfile's own directory unless a Compose file says another.

needs.description: Resources and other services this one talks to. Each one it names gets the service its address, in a variable.

environments.description: Overrides in one environment, by name.

version.description: The engine's version, such as "17" for Postgres. Without it, the provider chooses.

environments.description: Overrides in one environment, by name.

routes.description: Paths and the services they go to. The longest path that matches a request wins, so / catches whatever the others don't.

environments.description: Overrides in one environment, by name.

path.description: A path prefix, such as /api. It matches /api and anything under /api/.

strip_prefix.description: Remove the path before the request reaches the service, so /api/users arrives as /users.
